recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century modern album cover featuring a soft graphite pencil portrait of a woman with a bouffant hairstyle, set against a solid salmon-pink background. The layout uses a strong right-aligned typographic column and a bold, slanted header spanning the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The large, bold red header contrasts with the delicate grey pencil sketch.
The right-aligned text block balances the left-weighted portrait.
Horizontal black rules define the hierarchy of the artist name and tracklist.
coreInvariants: Heavy use of italicized sans-serif typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portrait is positioned slightly to the left of center, occupying the lower two-thirds of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold red title at the top serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top title to the portrait, then across to the right-aligned artist name and down the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample salmon-pink space surrounds the portrait to emphasize the delicate pencil work.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Salmon pink background providing a warm, vintage tone.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red for the primary title to create high impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for secondary text and divider lines; magenta-pink for the artist name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-saturation background with high-saturation red and magenta accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed sans-serif and high-contrast italic serif.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight for the main title with a strong rightward slant.
Condensed proportions for the tracklist to fit multiple lines in a narrow column.
Italicized, high-contrast forms for the artist name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold condensed sans-serif for impact paired with elegant italic serif for personality.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text in the top right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, slanted feel of the main title.
Captures the high-contrast, elegant serif feel for the artist name.
Appropriate for the clean, mid-century tracklist style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid salmon-pink background. In the lower left quadrant, place a soft, detailed graphite pencil sketch of a woman's face with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle, looking directly forward with a neutral expression. The sketch should have feathered edges that blend into the pink background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red italicized sans-serif title across the top. On the right side, create a column containing two thick black horizontal lines framing the artist's name in magenta italic serif. Below the second line, list a series of song titles in a clean, black, condensed sans-serif font, all right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent salmon-pink?
Is the portrait rendered in a pencil-sketch style?
Are the horizontal rules present and black?
Is the main title slanted and bold red?

mustAchieve: Delicate pencil texture in the portrait

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the portrait's facial features.
Check that the red title is sufficiently legible against the pink.
Verify the pencil sketch maintains a hand-drawn quality.
Confirm the right-alignment of the tracklist is precise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid pastel background + graphite pencil portrait + bold slanted header + right-aligned tracklist column with horizontal rules.
